### EQ001 — Stable-Schmidt-rank superposition constraint

*Defines the compression-feasible set.*

$$
\sum_i |\alpha_i|/\sqrt{M_i} \ge 1/\sqrt{m}
$$

status: `verified` · source: paper_tex: source publication material/main.tex:137-178; eq:coefs_lower_bound

Numerical form:

```
sum_i sqrt(p_i/M_i) >= 1/sqrt(m)
```

Code: `code/src/compressed_spectrum.py::compression_value`


### EQ002 — Feasibility maximum on the probability simplex

*Decides nonempty feasibility and excludes the ground-only point.*

$$
(\sum_i\sqrt{p_i/M_i})^2 \le \sum_i 1/M_i
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQ001` · source: paper_tex: source publication material/main.tex:178; Cauchy-Schwarz consequence

Numerical form:

```
sum(1/M_i) >= 1/m
```

Code: `code/src/compressed_spectrum.py::feasibility_status`


### EQ003 — Scalar dual and stationarity equation

*Reduces the convex program to a unique scalar root.*

$$
h(\nu)=\nu+[mS_1(\nu)]^{-1};\quad S_2(\nu)/m=S_1(\nu)^2
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQ001` · source: paper_tex: source publication material/main.tex:205-239; eq:dual and eq:dual_optimum_condition

Numerical form:

```
Bisect the unique zero of 1-S2/(m*S1**2) for nu<E1.
```

Code: `code/src/compressed_spectrum.py::solve_dual_root`


### EQ004 — Inverse-square optimal spectrum

*Generates the unique optimal six-level distribution.*

$$
p_i\propto [M_i(E_i-\nu^*)^2]^{-1}
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQ003` · source: paper_tex: source publication material/main.tex:236; eq:inv_square

Numerical form:

```
w_i=1/(M_i*(E_i-nu)^2); p_i=w_i/sum(w)
```

### EQ007 — Support lower bound and non-exponential tail

$$

$$
